verses.text: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests got to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They set it apart for God and put its doors in place. They rebuilt the wall as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel, and set it apart for God.
The men of Jericho built the next section, and Zaccur son of Imri built the section after that.
The sons of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They put in its beams and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.
Meremoth son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz, repaired the next section. Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah, son of Meshezabel, made repairs. Next to him, Zadok son of Baana made repairs.
The men of Tekoa repaired the next section, but their leaders refused to do the work their masters gave them.
Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah repaired the Old Gate. They put in its beams and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.
Next to them, Melatiah from Gibeon and Jadon from Meronoth, men from Gibeon and Mizpah, made repairs up to the home of the governor of the land west of the Euphrates River.
Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfume makers, made repairs. They rebuilt Jerusalem's wall as far as the Broad Wall.
Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of half of the Jerusalem district, made repairs.
Next to them, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his own house. Next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired another section and the Tower of the Ovens.
Next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half of the Jerusalem district, made repairs with the help of his daughters.

Hanun and the people of Zanoah repaired the Valley Gate. They rebuilt it and set up its doors, bolts, and bars. They also repaired about four hundred fifty meters of the wall, as far as the Garbage Gate.
Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem, repaired the Garbage Gate. He rebuilt it and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.

Shallun son of Col-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate. He rebuilt it, put a roof on it, and set up its doors, bolts, and bars. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam by the King's Garden, as far as the steps that go down from the City of David.
After him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to the place across from David's tombs, as far as the man-made pool and the House of the Heroes.
After him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani. Next to him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his own district.
After him, their fellow Levites made repairs under Bavvai son of Henadad, ruler of the other half of the district of Keilah.
Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, across from the slope up to the armory, at the corner of the wall.
After him, Baruch son of Zabbai worked hard to repair another section, from the corner to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
After him, Meremoth son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the door of Eliashib's house to the end of it.
After him, the priests from the surrounding area made repairs.
After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, son of Ananiah, made repairs next to his own house.
After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah's house to the bend and the corner of the wall.

Palal son of Uzai made repairs across from the bend of the wall and the tower that sticks out from the king's upper palace, near the courtyard of the guard. After him, Pedaiah son of Parosh made repairs.
The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, as far as the place across from the Water Gate on the east and the tower that sticks out.
After them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from across the large tower that sticks out to the wall of Ophel.
Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each one across from his own house.
After them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs across from his house. After him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.
After him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. After them, Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs across from where he lived.
After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, across from the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner.
The goldsmiths and merchants made repairs between the room above the corner and the Sheep Gate.
